mentions.name: Argo
mentions.description: Argo is a conversational AI interviewing platform built with emotional intelligence, designed to make conversations comfortable and engaging rather than feeling like interrogation. Beyond a chatbot, it works as a deep real-time knowledge capture framework that helps people capture stories through interviews, inspired by long-form conversationalists like Joe Rogan and Lex Fridman. A consumer app is live, with a B2B version in development.
mentions.problem: Interviews can feel like interrogation and cause conversation fatigue, and personal stories go uncaptured, leaving gaps between moments like two photos.
mentions.audience: Businesses and consumers who want to capture stories and knowledge through comfortable conversation
mentions.source_excerpt:
On a mission to build the best interviewer platform with emotional intelligence, to make the conversation comfortable and engaging for the user. 
Not just a chatbot, but a deep real-time knowledge capture framework with conversational AI.

Our first consumer product is Argo https://getargoai.com, but we're working on a B2B version as well.
